result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count no longer includes cancelled purchase orders. I added `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the count subquery in `DataStore.findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` (`DataStore.java`, around line 6517).

That is the same filter the per-quarter purchase-order report uses. Reps with no purchase orders in the period still appear with 0, and the sort order is unchanged.

I ran `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCount*` and `DemoScenarioTest`, and both passed. I didn't add a test for your Anna/Bob example, so the cancelled-order case isn't covered by a test of its own.
